faq.q: How much does Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein charge?
faq.a: Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein have offices?
faq.a: Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein publishes three offices, in Manhattan, Garden City and Alhambra. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein?
faq.a: Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein names 22 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 4 of 22 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 18 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: Are the case results Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein publishes nine case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.a: Raiser, Kenniff & Lonstein scores 56 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration.
